// RED probe — rule 1 (JSX text interpolation of a raw identity column).
// The shape CoverageInsightsClient shipped: the raw column rendered as text.
export function Probe({ policy }: { policy: { insurerName: string; policyNumber: string } }) {
    return (
        <div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{policy.insurerName}</div>
            <span>{policy.policyNumber}</span>
        </div>
    )
}
